{{nihongo|'''Tagi Shrine'''|多岐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Tagi Shrine''' (たぎじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Yōrō, Gifu|ar|يورو (اليابان)|arz|بلده يورو|ceb|Yōrō-chō|de|Yōrō (Gifu)|es|Yōrō (Gifu)|fa|یورو، گیفو|fr|Yōrō|it|Yōrō|ja|養老町|ko|요로정|ms|Yōrō, Gifu|my|ယေားရေားမြို့၊ ဂိဖု|pl|Yōrō|ru|Йоро (посёлок)|sv|Yōrō|tl|Yōrō, Gifu|tr|Yōrō (kasaba)|uk|Йоро (Ґіфу)|ur|یورو، گیفو|uz|Yōrō (Gifu)|zh|養老町|qid=Q153814}}, {{ill|Yōrō District, Gifu|ceb|Yōrō-gun|es|Distrito de Yōrō (Gifu)|fr|District de Yōrō|id|Distrik Yōrō, Gifu|it|Distretto di Yōrō|ja|養老郡|ko|요로군|pl|Powiat Yōrō|pt|Distrito de Yoro|uk|Повіт Йоро|zh|養老郡|qid=Q1155060}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. It is regarded as the {{ill|Sannomiya|eu|Sannomiya|fa|ساننومیا|ja|三宮|ko|산노미야|ru|Санномия|th|ซันโนะมิยะ|zh|三宮|qid=Q7418864|lt=third shrine}} of {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}}.

It is a shrine of {{ill|Tagi district|ja|多芸郡|zh|多藝郡|qid=Q11431050}}, Mino Province. The name Tagi is said to derive from the words of {{ill|Yamato Takeru|Q461258|qid=Q461258}}: “My feet no longer walk; they have become weary (tagiragi).”

===Enshrined deities===
*{{ill|Ukanomitama|de|Ukanomitama|eo|Ukanomitama|fr|Uka-no-Mitama|ja|ウカノミタマ|mni|ꯎꯀꯅꯣꯃꯤꯇꯃ|ru|Ука-но митама|simple|Ukanomitama|sv|Ukanomitama|th|อูกาโนมิตามะ|zh|宇迦之御魂神|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Kami}} (うかのみたまのかみ)
*{{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}} (すさのおのみこと)

It is said to enshrine the ancestral deity of the Tagi clan who ruled this area in ancient times.

===History===
* Said to date to the {{ill|Wadō (era)|ar|وادو (حقبة)|de|Wadō (Ära)|es|Wadō|fa|وادو (دوره)|fr|Ère Wadō|ia|Wado|id|Wadō|ja|和銅|ko|와도|pt|Wadō (era)|ru|Вадо|simple|Wadō (era)|sr|Вадо (ера)|th|วาโด|tr|Wadō|uk|Вадо (ненґо)|zh|和銅|zh_yue|和銅|qid=Q1373026}} era, but the founding date is unknown.
* In {{ill|1189|ab|1189|af|1189|als|1189|am|1189 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1189|ar|1189|ary|1189|arz|1189|ast|1189|avk|1189|az|1189|azb|۱۱۸۹ (میلادی)|bcl|1189|be|1189|be_x_old|1189|bg|1189|bn|১১৮৯|bpy|মারি ১১৮৯|br|1189|bs|1189.|ca|1189|cdo|1189 nièng|ceb|1189|ckb|١١٨٩|crh|1189|cs|1189|cv|1189|cy|1189|da|1189|de|1189|diq|1189|el|1189|eml|1189|eo|1189|es|1189|et|1189|eu|1189|fa|۱۱۸۹ (میلادی)|fi|1189|fo|1189|fr|1189|frr|1189|fy|1189|ga|1189|gan|1189年|gcr|1189|gd|1189|gl|1189|gv|1189|he|1189|hi|११८९|hr|1189.|ht|1189 (almanak jilyen)|hu|1189|hy|1189|id|1189|ilo|1189|io|1189|is|1189|it|1189|ja|1189年|jv|1189|ka|1189|kaa|1189|kk|1189 жыл|ko|1189년|la|1189|lb|1189|lij|1189|lmo|1189|lt|1189 m.|lv|1189. gads|map_bms|1189|mdf|1189|mg|1189|mhr|1189|mi|1189|min|1189|mk|1189|mr|इ.स. ११८९|mrj|1189 и|ms|1189|mzn|۱۱۸۹|nah|1189|nap|1189|nds|1189|nds_nl|1189|new|सन् ११८९|nl|1189|nn|1189|no|1189|nrm|1189|nso|1189|oc|1189|or|୧୧୮୯|os|1189-æм аз|pl|1189|pnb|1189|pt|1189|qu|1189|ro|1189|ru|1189 год|rue|1189|sa|११८९|scn|1189|sd|1189ع|se|1189|sh|1189.|shn|1189|simple|1189|sk|1189|sl|1189|smn|1189|sq|1189|sr|1189|su|1189|sv|1189|sw|1189|tg|Соли 1189|th|พ.ศ. 1732|tk|1189|tl|1189|tly|1189|tr|1189|tt|1189 ел|uk|1189|ur|1189ء|uz|1189|vec|1189|vi|1189|vls|1189|war|1189|wuu|1189年|xmf|1189|zh|1189年|zh_min_nan|1189 nî|zh_yue|1189年|qid=Q19735}} ({{ill|Bunji (era)|Q1194415|qid=Q1194415}} 5), a {{ill|Sutra mound|Q7650105|qid=Q7650105|lt=nyohōkyō-zuka}} was built (on the round mound behind the shrine buildings).
* Around 1550-1560 ({{ill|Kōji (Muromachi period)|Q1143910|qid=Q1143910|lt=Kōji}} / {{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}}), shrine lands were confiscated due to upheaval.
* In {{ill|1585|Q6736|qid=Q6736}} ({{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} 13), it suffered major flood damage. This flood changed the course of the {{ill|Kiso River|Q779607|qid=Q779607}}, altered the border between {{ill|Owari Province|Q514506|qid=Q514506}} and Mino Province, and shifted parts of Owari districts into Mino districts.
* After the {{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} era, shrine buildings and related structures were restored.
* In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6), it was designated {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.
* In {{ill|1913|Q2080|qid=Q2080}} (Taishō 2), during prolonged drought, three kinds of rice (early/mid/late) grew in front of the shrine office, drawing many worshipers as a miracle (a monument remains beside the shrine).
* On March 18, {{ill|1962|Q2764|qid=Q2764}} (Shōwa 37), it was designated by Gifu Prefecture Shrine Office as a prefectural designated shrine with head attendance ({{ill|Kinpei-sha|Q119929592|qid=Q119929592}}), designation No. 60{{sfn|Kimura|1997|p=95}}.
